name: Fathom
one_liner: AI meeting recorder that provides summaries, transcripts and recordings via a REST API and webhooks.
auth_notes: API key per user from User Settings → API Access, sent as X-Api-Key. OAuth available for apps other users install; refresh tokens are single-use and rotate.
access_notes: Generate an API key in User Settings → API Access. The FAQ says API access (keys and webhooks) is included on all plans. API keys are per user; there are no org-level keys.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve API key included on all plans, documented REST API with webhooks and OpenAPI spec, and standard auth. Rate limits apply (60 calls per minute globally).

identity.quote: This documentation describes Fathom’s REST API.

auth.quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website’s settings area.
Refresh tokens are one-time-use and rotate on each refresh

access.quote: Yes. API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans.
API keys are per user, not per org, and there are no org-level keys.

api_surface.quote: Currently, you are able to make a maximum of 60 calls to the API in a 60 second window.
There is no bulk endpoint; pagination is the way to retrieve large sets.
Create a webhook to receive new meeting content.
Get started with Fathom using our official TypeScript and Python SDKs

mcp.quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server
